description: This PHP class `DatabaseBackupService` provides methods for managing database savepoints, including creating, restoring, and deleting savepoints in a testing context, utilizing cache and database schema management.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: Service class for managing database savepoints for testing, including creation, restoration, and deletion, with support for cache and schema management.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine DBAL Connection object.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for database schema operations.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache adapter for storing savepoint data.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKeyPrefix
methods.description: Generates a cache key prefix for a savepoint based on its name.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key for a specific table within a savepoint.

methods.name: createSavepoint
methods.description: Creates a new savepoint with a specified name by caching the current state of all tables.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates an initial savepoint, clearing existing savepoints first.

methods.name: _createSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method to create a savepoint, caching table data.

methods.name: restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Restores the database to a specified savepoint by reverting data from cache.

methods.name: restoreToInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Restores the database to the initial savepoint.

methods.name: _restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method to restore data from a cache savepoint into the database.

methods.name: deleteSavepoints
methods.description: Deletes multiple savepoints or all if none specified.

methods.name: _deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method to delete savepoint data from cache.

methods.name: deleteAllSavepoints
methods.description: Deletes all savepoints and the initial savepoint.
